notes: Counter-depth side-by-side with ice and water dispenser and a variable-capacity (inverter-driven) compressor. Covers KSBS25FKBL00, KSBS25FKBT00, KSBS25FKWH00 and sister models KSBP25FKSS00, KSCS25FKSS00, KSFS25FK**00.

gaps: The job aid gives operating voltages and test resistances but no part numbers for the parts claimed here (the only one seen is for 5/16 in. tubing unions) and no compressor maker or model.
Ice maker auger motor (about 2-4 ohms) is listed but its supply voltage is not stated, so it is not claimed.
method: Source: Whirlpool Corporation technical education job aid 4317290A, 'KitchenAid 2001 K Model Counter Depth Side-By-Side Refrigerator With Variable Capacity Compressor' (copyright 2002).
Read as text from the PDF on 2026-11-12 (Internet Archive copy of a ManualZilla upload; no copy on a Whirlpool domain was found).
Page numbers are the printed job-aid pages.
The 'years' value is the model year in the job aid's title.

comps.spec: Variable-capacity compressor fed three-phase 230 VAC by the inverter board, speed 1620-4500 rpm set by frequency; windings about 9-10 ohms between any two of the three pins; R134a system (job aid pp. 1-5, 3-3, 5-3)

Inverter assembly beside the compressor in the unit compartment: 120 VAC in, 3-6 VDC drive signal from the main control board, has current limiting and thermal protection so no compressor-mounted thermal protector is used (pp. 3-3, 4-17, 5-3)
Evaporator fan motor, 12 VDC variable speed, four wires (speed feedback, constant 12 V, 5-17 VDC speed control, common), 2000-3000 rpm; about 1400-1700 ohms across pins 1 and 4 (pp. 3-3, 5-2)
Condenser fan motor in the unit compartment, 120 VAC when running (pp. 4-1, 5-2, 5-5)

Air door driven by a reversible DC stepper motor on 12 V square-wave pulses, separate open and close windings, about 400-450 ohms across yellow-white and across red-blue, 1800 positions over 0-90 degrees; located with the touch control assembly (pp. 3-3, 4-1, 5-4)
Defrost bimetal: closed below 20 F, open above 50 F (p. 5-4)
Refrigerator and freezer thermistors, about 8750 ohms at 32 F, fed about 5 VDC by the main control board (pp. 4-1, 5-1, 5-5)
Water valve in the unit compartment with two solenoids: ice maker (1/4 in. outlet, about 160-170 ohms) and water dispenser (5/16 in. outlet, about 330-355 ohms) (pp. 4-1, 4-22, 5-7)
Crush/cube solenoid on the auger assembly housing, about 35-45 ohms (pp. 4-10, 5-6)
40 W bulb behind the light shield of the touch control assembly; separate refrigerator and freezer light sockets (pp. 4-2, 4-6)
Refrigerator and freezer door switches, identical, normally closed (pp. 4-5, 5-7)

Main control board assembly in the rear unit compartment: 120 VAC supply in; outputs 12 VDC to the display board, 5 VDC to thermistors, 120 VAC to condenser fan and defrost heater, 3-6 VDC compressor drive, 12 VDC evaporator fan; held on five standoffs (pp. 4-18, 4-19, 5-5)
